description.value: 10 Acres Commons is a lively, full-service restaurant in downtown Victoria operated by the 10 Acres Farm & Restaurants group, which sources ingredients from its own farm and runs four unique dining locations across Greater Victoria and Sidney. Described as 'Fun & Lively,' it occupies a central downtown location on Humboldt Street, making it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the city core. The farm-to-table ethos and late-night hours make it a distinctive dining option for touring cyclists ending a long day on the road.
